Method description: Generated using analytical fluence calculation at 10 cm depth in water for 2 MeV photons, 10x10 cm field. Primary fluence = Phi0*exp(-μ*10). First Compton scatter fluence computed via MC integration of Klein-Nishina differential cross section over beam volume. Multiple scatter and annihilation contributions approximated. Interactions sampled from combined fluence spectrum weighted by energy-dependent total cross section. Kinematics from Klein-Nishina (Compton), Bethe-Heitler approximation (pair), forward-peaked (Rayleigh, photoelectric).
